name: Editorial Tri-Tone
avoid_for: Decks that need to read as soft or comforting — the burgundy/pink/cream tri-tone is intentionally high-contrast and styled
weak_cases: Three colors cannot distinguish unlimited series; inline font switches may complicate dense multilingual copy.
visual_signature: Pink, butter and burgundy with grotesque/serif inline contrast and mono colophon.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Latin roman/italic and face-switch emphasis may not transfer; define emphasis for the audience's script.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
